name: Foran Energy Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Foran Energy Group Co., Ltd. transports and sells natural gas in China. The company engages in the provision of energy services, such as petrochemical products, hydrogen and thermal energy, photovoltaics, energy storage, and green methanol; research, development, and manufacture of fuel cells, hydrogen energy equipment, pipeline testing, and kiln thermal equipment; and petrochemical and natural gas supply chain, and life service business. It also provides pipeline inspection and information management, gas engineering, and energy conservation, and emission reduction services.
